r2LiveTests.catalogUrlsParentSlug: /product-category/gun-shop/ returns 404 — 'gun-shop' is NOT a real WP taxonomy term. WP REST product_cat?slug=gun-shop returns []. URLs WITH and WITHOUT gun-shop/ prefix both 200 (permalink rewrite resolves both). Canonical form per WP REST .link field has NO prefix.

auditNotes.verifyMethodPolicy: detail-page selected: restock alerts required. store-api would silently drop OOS-transition / restock detection for products the batch API does not return (worker.ts:549/711 early-return).
auditNotes.wcCountSurface: wp-rest-core /wp-json/wp/v2/product (972) chosen to match watermark surface; in-stock visible total is 582 (Store API /wc/store/v1/products, /shop/ shows 577 results)
auditNotes.wcCategoryApi: WP REST core /wp/v2/product_cat preferred (non-recursive, returns parent=0 top-level set deterministically). WC Store API also available but recurses subcategories.
auditNotes.sgcaptchaPathScope: All catalog/API paths gated; root / returns 200 on iPhone UA without challenge. Runtime waf-cookie-manager (waf-cookie-manager.ts:120) recognizes /.well-known/sgcaptcha/ challenge path.
auditNotes.wafTypeNote: Marked 'sgcaptcha' for runtime: matches existing SG handler (Mistake 30). The 403 on desktop UA at root is the same SiteGround security stack — iPhone UA override is the canonical fix.
